title.narrative: Support to Quality Infrastructure in Armenia

description.narrative: The EU Action is a national technical assistance programme aimed at supporting the Republic of Armenia, through the National Body for Standards and Metrology, to provide sustainable and internationally recognized metrology services to stakeholders. Within this context, the proposed methodology will seek to impact both the supply of metrology services available within Armenia as well as the demand for these services by stakeholders. Both elements are critical for ensuring the sustainability.
